scope: Deterministic evaluator checks only. No LLM judge was added.

defects.root_cause: The lift pattern '...더라도 ... 됩니다' fired on '받았더라도 ... 엄격히 금지됩니다'; the exclusion list held 불인정/불허/불가/않/없 but not an asserted 금지.
defects.fix: An asserted prohibition (금지됩니다/된다/되어 있/합니다/입니다 ...) excludes a lift. '금지 대상이 아니' is not an asserted prohibition and still lifts.
also_found: Pre-existing false negative: a page saying '...금지됩니다' was never read as a limit, so a reversal of it was never caught. The asserted prohibition now counts on the evidence side.
New false positive exposed by that change: '허가 취소 및 출국조치 대상이 될 수 있습니다' read as a permission. A possible sanction is excluded from the allow path.

defects.root_cause: For the period '6개월', the nearest role word after it in the evidence was '재발급' of '재발급 수수료', a fee name, read as role 'issue'.
defects.fix: For periods, a procedural word directly followed by a fee noun (수수료/심사료/요금/비용) is skipped as a role word. Money still reads its fee noun.

defects.root_cause: Required facts were exact substrings; '2,000명 쿼터 기준은 완전히 폐기' failed '2,000명 쿼터 기준은 폐기'.
defects.fix: required_fact_present: exact match first; else remove a fixed list of degree/emphasis adverbs from the answer only and match again, refusing a match negated right after. Matches found this way are listed in details.normalized_fact_matches.
kept_sensitive_to: dropped obligation words in the fact
defects.known_limit: The exact-match path keeps its old weakness that a fact followed by a negation still matches; polarity checks remain the guard for that.

defects.check: language of required facts vs contract language
defects.root_cause: v1 asks for Korean answers; DEV-011 required facts are English and DEV-012 Vietnamese.
defects.fix: Not a scoring fix. score_dev20.language_review emits review_required: rubric_language_mismatch per case and contract version; pass/fail is unchanged. Expected answers are unchanged.
